method: Playwright against locally running API and Vite with dedicated disposable PostgreSQL database
scope: All tests/e2e except compose-stack.spec.ts; one worker; Chromium Desktop Chrome and Pixel 7 projects
notes: The API was built from the working tree containing the changes later committed as 37200bf; backend and frontend source have no diff between 37200bf and 7adffff.
Runtime metadata records an earlier HEAD because the API was built before those source changes were committed.
One case checks API health through Playwright request context rather than a rendered browser page.
This is local evidence and does not replace GitHub CI, manual screen-reader speech, real mobile touch or staging validation.
